correctness.rationale: For a full two-phase fixed configuration, any moving E would occupy a previously vacant cell that N movement cannot restore; analogously for N. This proves the exact two blocked-neighbor predicates and bijective 18-state cyclic transfer. The weighted zeta follows from the trace-determinant identity. An executable exact-arithmetic matrix construction reproduces the complete two-quartic factorization and weighted derivatives. An independent exhaustive implementation of the original two-substep dynamics matches every ternary input count at n=3,4,5. A strict Rouché/Cauchy separation proves a unique dominant root and the entropy; analytic perturbation gives occupancy limits. The computations are finite exact certificates and the local transfer proof extends to all n>=3.

value.rationale: Height three is the first uncomplicated vertically non-aliased periodic BML strip beyond height two. The theorem is a natural all-length exact classification of already-frozen configurations at every joint species population, not an arbitrary finite slice. Its 18-state zeta collapses to two quartic spectral factors and determines a stationary entropy and a high-occupancy (about 86.11%) conditional density. This quantitatively separates static microstate abundance from dynamic jamming onset and provides a reusable narrow-strip benchmark.
